title: Canonical etale finite quotient internal-Hom arrow
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension and $X$ a scheme. Use the positive finite coefficient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and the ambient derived module categories on the small etale site. For $n\geq m\geq1$, let $F_{n,m}$ be derived scalar extension along the actual quotient $A_{E,n}\to A_{E,m}$ of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. With the published derived internal Hom $H_n$ and the canonical tensor comparison $\mu:F_{n,m}(T\otimes^L K)\cong F_{n,m}T\otimes^L F_{n,m}K$, define $v^{n,m}_{K,M}:F_{n,m}H_n(K,M)\to H_m(F_{n,m}K,F_{n,m}M)$ to be the tensor-Hom transpose of $\mu^{-1}$ followed by $F_{n,m}(\mathrm{ev}_n)$. The closed adjunction uses the published Koszul symmetry to put the Hom object first. For $n\geq m\geq r\geq1$, use the canonical scalar associator $F_{m,r}\circ F_{n,m}\cong F_{n,r}$, whose restriction adjoint is the identity-on-sections quotient composition. The intrinsic pro-etale operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] are reused for the corresponding pro-etale arrow and associator, rather than replaced. The etale tensor representative data are the actual local sheafified pure tensors followed by signed-total summand inclusions, and the localization tensorator of the published derived-category localization, transported to this uniquely normalized closed tensor. The intrinsic localization functor is the standard one of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

proof.text: For the closed-normalization clause, construct the closed record from the published monoidal structure, the specified Koszul-braided right-tensor adjunction and finiteHomEvaluation_naturality. Share the derived internal Hom, adjunction and normalization at the generic coefficient category before specializing to etale sheaves. This is the same normalization, with its definition bodies factored.

For uniqueness of the normalized closed record, eliminate equality of the monoidal field, apply function extensionality and eq_of_heq to the adjunction fields, and use proof irrelevance for evaluation naturality. The canonical comparison arrow and scalar associators remain as stated.

For representative data, first apply congrArg to the monoidal-field equality of the canonical closed normalization. Combine this with the quotient-family closed-field normalization to identify each closed tensor with the native derived tensor. The local generators are the existing sheafified pure tensors followed by signed-total summand inclusions. The model maps are the existing native localization tensorators, transported along the tensor-family equality. Equality elimination constructs the representative record and proves its heterogeneous normalization. For any other normalized record, eq_of_heq and dependent function extensionality identify both its generator and model fields with those of this record, proving uniqueness.

The representative normalization is boxed generically, preserving exactly the generator and model clauses. Bundle each source category, tensor and localization together before forming the representative family. Give the same signed-total inclusion its native projected codomain before etale specialization, avoiding expanded tensor-object comparisons.
